claims.statement: REUSE is sound iff every load-bearing premise is UNCHANGED or ENTAILED.
A single CONTRADICTED load-bearing premise makes REUSE unsound, irrecoverably by checking other premises.

With no CONTRADICTED premise but some UNKNOWN premise the licensed output is CANNOT_CHECK; collapsing UNKNOWN to UNCHANGED gives unsound reuse and collapsing it to CONTRADICTED gives unnecessary revocation.
When transport fails the recomputation set is exactly the affected closure over the support DAG, and no nonnegative weighting yields a cheaper sound set.
No two-valued transport rule is both sound and non-over-revoking; the three-valued rule is the unique such point.

enumeration.support_dags: all DAGs on 3..4 premise nodes under a fixed topological order
enumeration.status_assignments: every assignment of UNCHANGED/ENTAILED/CONTRADICTED/UNKNOWN to every premise

controls.statement: The optimistic collapse MUST be caught producing unsound reuse on at least one case, through the same soundness predicate the three-valued rule is judged by. If it is never caught, the predicate cannot fire and no negative result means anything.

The pessimistic collapse must be sound in EVERY case and strictly over-revoke in at least one. Both halves are required: soundness shows the control is not merely broken, over-revocation shows the three-valued rule is not vacuous.
With every premise UNCHANGED all three rules must REUSE and none may be flagged unsound. A checker that alarms on the all-clear case cries wolf.
The sweep must contain cases with UNKNOWN and no CONTRADICTED premise, or P3 — the entire point — is untested.

conditions: P1 to P5 hold with no counterexample
terminals.licenses: A bounded statement that three-valued premise status is necessary and sufficient for sound, minimal certificate transport, and that no two-valued rule achieves both.
does_not_license: any claim that the pinned corpus establishes transport

conditions: P1 or P2 has a counterexample
some two-valued collapse is both sound and never over-revokes
terminals.reading: The three-valued distinction would then be unnecessary, and the paper's central claim would collapse.

external_corpus.consequence: NO FROZEN TEST IS RUN AGAINST IT; any reference is a labelled retrospective observation evidencing nothing.
external_corpus.boundary_recorded_by_the_corpus_itself: every TEST_EXIT fact is CANNOT_CHECK because the locked per-repository runtime does not exist — an UNKNOWN premise in the sense of P3, not a refuted one

stop_rule: Outcomes are read once. On T2 or T3 the law is refuted and the lane stops. On T1 the theorem stands but, because the external corpus records its own CANNOT_CHECK boundary rather than crossing it, #1649's stop rule keeps ORION-23 bounded and forbids any external deployment claim.
